Activated the hooks and corrected pre-push. Root cause was that activation depended on husky's npm prepare script, which never runs in a cargo/bun/mise repository, so core.hooksPath stayed unset in every clone. Added tools/install-git-hooks.ts to set core.hooksPath to .husky without needing node, exposed as mise run hooks:install and hooks:check, and made mise run init depend on it so a normal setup activates hooks. Wired it as a dependency rather than into the init body so it also runs on Windows without POSIX bash. Found and fixed a second reason the hooks would not have run even once activated: all three were mode 100644 in the index, and git silently skips non-executable hooks on Linux and macOS; they are now 100755. Rewrote pre-push, which claimed to check Go formatting and ran cargo clippy --all-targets plus cargo test --workspace, taking many minutes and not linking on some machines; it now runs mise run fmt-check only, measured at 1.6s, with a MORPHIR_SKIP_HOOKS=1 escape hatch, on the reasoning that CI already gates lint and tests and a hook slow enough to be bypassed protects nothing. Verified the EasyCLA guard end to end by committing a message carrying a Co-Authored-By Claude trailer and confirming the stored message came back without it.

Added a drift check and wired it into the commit path. tools/check-beads-drift.ts compares bd export against .beads/issues.jsonl by id, status and priority, deliberately ignoring the dependencies array because bd emits its entries in a non-deterministic order that produces diff churn without meaning disagreement. Exposed as mise run beads:drift-check, and the pre-commit hook runs it when .beads/issues.jsonl is staged, which is the moment the drift would be introduced. Verified against all three drift kinds by injecting each into a copy of the export: an issue only in the database, an issue only in the export, and a status disagreement, all detected, then confirmed a real commit with a drifted export is blocked while an in-sync one passes. Documented the invariant in AGENTS.md along with the worktree gotcha that bd resolves .beads to the main checkout even when the cwd is a linked worktree. The drift that prompted this was already reconciled in PR #748.
